title: Surreal Fairy in Dream Realm
description: A central fairy woman with glowing yellow wings and a flower crown stands in a vibrant, surreal fantasy landscape. She is surrounded by melting clocks, a red dragon, a golden retriever puppy, a hammer-wielding woman on stairs, flying books, bats, eyeballs in the sky, and gothic ruins under a starry and golden moonlit sky.
prompt: A beautiful woman with glowing yellow butterfly wings and a flower crown stands at the center of a surreal dreamscape, her body covered in living vines and flowers. To her left a red dragon and melting clock with a golden retriever puppy, to her right a woman in blue holding a giant hammer on stairs near another melting clock. Flying books, bats, eyeballs floating in a starry night sky with a gothic castle and moon in the background, intricate symbolic details, highly detailed fantasy art.
